answer: Stake-weighted admission is the shield. Each agent identity must lock a bond of quartz-denominated credits before transacting, and that bond sits idle instead of earning yield. A thousand fake agents means locking a thousand deposits, so the sybil farm sinks real capital per voice bought. Reputation compounds only on aged identities, and each new peer needs attestation from an older one under a shared ember of trust, so clones start cold. A cheap lantern scan flags clusters whose deposits trace to one funder and slashes those bonds.
